description: Latiffianti, Effi and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. The deposit supplies the computer code used by the named 2025 Annals of Applied Statistics study. Its object is an accumulation method for early fault warning in wind-turbine systems. A separate WEICan generator dataset supplies the associated observations and is linked as data, not counted as another implementation. Native descriptors list a code archive and reproducibility report. Exact input channels, alarm thresholds and source language are not described in the abstract, so they remain unknown. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. The source establishes an implemented or evaluated model. Public source-code availability remains unknown unless explicitly identified below. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance.
